objective: Implement YamlConfigStore in app/yaml_store.py (get/set/save/as_dict, REQUIRED_KEYS, ConfigError('config file missing: <path>')) over a vendored YAML-subset parser for flat scalar maps (stdlib only), and add tests/test_yaml_store.py with the full A1 5-item parity matrix (the tests/test_config.py matrix mirrored 1:1, plus as_dict copy semantics and REQUIRED_KEYS parity); loader.py and cli.py stay on JSON (DA-1).

concepts: YAML-subset parse/serialize for flat scalar maps
interface parity testing against a reference implementation

inputs: C1 store interface spec (inlined in frozen_contracts)

frozen_contracts.spec: ConfigStore interface: get(key, default=None) -> value; set(key, value) -> None (persists immediately); save() -> None (persists current state); as_dict() -> dict (shallow copy). Class attribute REQUIRED_KEYS = ('app_name', 'env', 'log_level'). Constructor takes a file path; missing file raises ConfigError('config file missing: <path>'). Both JsonConfigStore and YamlConfigStore satisfy this interface identically.
config data shape: flat dict; required keys app_name (str), env (str), log_level (one of debug|info|warning|error); all values scalar (str/number/bool). No nested structures.

non_goals: wiring loader.py/cli.py to the YAML store (DA-1 — that is the route stage)
supporting nested YAML structures (A-1: flat scalar maps only)
changing CLI flags or loader error message shapes
implementation_constraints: stdlib only — the YAML subset parser is vendored inside yaml_store.py (no third-party yaml package)
parser scope: flat map of scalar values (str/number/bool); anything outside the subset raises ConfigError with a documented message (state the subset in the module docstring)
class attribute REQUIRED_KEYS and constructor missing-file behavior identical to JsonConfigStore per C1
test style: unittest, covering the A1 5-item parity matrix (tests/test_config.py mirrored 1:1 + as_dict copy semantics + REQUIRED_KEYS parity) so parity is structural, not ad hoc

deliverables.what: parity test matrix (A1 5-item matrix: tests/test_config.py mirrored 1:1 + as_dict copy semantics + REQUIRED_KEYS parity)

acceptance_tests.description: set('feature_x', True) then reload from file: get returns True and as_dict contains all keys (C1 roundtrip)
YamlConfigStore on a nonexistent path raises ConfigError with the 'config file missing:' prefix (C1)
save-then-reload of a C2-shape config file returns an identical dict (A2 roundtrip fidelity)
nested input to the subset parser raises ConfigError with the documented message — no silent partial parse
as_dict() returns a shallow copy: mutating the returned dict leaves the store's state unchanged (a subsequent as_dict() returns values equal to the pre-mutation dict)
REQUIRED_KEYS parity: YamlConfigStore.REQUIRED_KEYS == ('app_name', 'env', 'log_level') and equals JsonConfigStore.REQUIRED_KEYS

failure_cases.scenario: parser encounters a value type outside str/number/bool (e.g. a list)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: raise ConfigError('yaml subset unsupported: <kind>') — never a partial parse

failure_cases.scenario: config file uses CRLF line endings or a UTF-8 BOM
failure_cases.expected_behavior: the parse returns data equal to the clean-UTF8 parse (whitespace/encoding tolerated, values unchanged)

handoff.notes: the parity matrix in tests/test_yaml_store.py is the seam S1 proof; the closure task re-runs it (gate E1) — do not trim the matrix to save time

warnings.detail: the YAML subset parser is new code with no reference implementation in the repo
warnings.rationale: the 1:1 parity matrix against JsonConfigStore is the control; the parser is kept strictly at flat scalar maps (A-1), and p80 sits exactly at leaf_p80_max — if execution exceeds it, checkpoint_and_split around the parser
